verses.en: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
verses.pt: Amo o SENHOR, porque ele escuta minha voz e minhas súplicas.
verses.en_web: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
verses.en_bbe: I have given my love to the Lord, because he has given ear to the voice of my cry and my prayer.

verses.en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
verses.pt: Porque ele tem inclinado a mim seus ouvidos; por isso eu clamarei a ele em todos os meus dias.
verses.en_web: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
verses.en_bbe: He has let my request come before him, and I will make my prayer to him all my days.

verses.en: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.pt: Cordas da morte me cercaram, e angústias do Xeol me afrontaram; encontrei opressão e aflição.
verses.en_web: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.en_bbe: The nets of death were round me, and the pains of the underworld had me in their grip; I was full of trouble and sorrow.

verses.en: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
verses.pt: Mas clamei ao nome do SENHOR, dizendo: Ah SENHOR, livra minha alma!
verses.en_web: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
verses.en_bbe: Then I made my prayer to the Lord, saying, O Lord, take my soul out of trouble.

verses.en: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
verses.pt: O SENHOR é piedoso e justo; e nosso Deus é misericordioso.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is full of grace and righteousness; truly, he is a God of mercy.

verses.en: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
verses.pt: O SENHOR protege os simples; eu estava com graves problemas, mas ele me livrou.
verses.en_web: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord keeps the simple; I was made low, and he was my saviour.

verses.en: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.pt: Minha alma, volta ao teu descanso, pois o SENHOR tem te tratado bem.
verses.en_web: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
verses.en_bbe: Come back to your rest, O my soul; for the Lord has given you your reward.

verses.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.pt: Porque tu, SENHOR,livraste minha alma da morte, meus olhos das lágrimas, e meu pé do tropeço.
verses.en_web: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.en_bbe: You have taken my soul from the power of death, keeping my eyes from weeping, and my feet from falling.

verses.en: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.pt: Andarei diante do SENHOR na terra dos viventes.
verses.en_web: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.
verses.en_bbe: I will go before the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.en: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
verses.pt: Eu cri, por isso falei; estive muito aflito.
verses.en_web: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
verses.en_bbe: I still had faith, though I said, I am in great trouble;

verses.en: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
verses.pt: Eu dizia em minha pressa: Todo homem é mentiroso.
verses.en_web: I said in my haste, “All men are liars.”
verses.en_bbe: Though I said in my fear, All men are false.

verses.en: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
verses.pt: O que pagarei ao SENHOR por todos os benefícios dele para mim?
verses.en_web: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
verses.en_bbe: What may I give to the Lord for all the good things which he has done for me?

verses.en: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.pt: Tomarei o copo da salvação, e chamarei o nome do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.
verses.en_bbe: I will take the cup of salvation, and give praise to the name of the Lord.

verses.en: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
verses.pt: Certamente pagarei meus votos ao SENHOR, na presença de todo o seu povo.
verses.en_web: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.
verses.en_bbe: I will make the offering of my oath to the Lord, even before all his people.

verses.en: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
verses.pt: Preciosa é aos olhos do SENHOR a morte de seus santos.
verses.en_web: Precious in Yahweh’s sight is the death of his saints.
verses.en_bbe: Dear in the eyes of the Lord is the death of his saints.

verses.en: O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
verses.pt: Ah SENHOR, verdadeiramente eu sou teu servo; sou teu servo, filho de tua serva; tu me soltaste das correntes que me prendiam.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant. You have freed me from my chains.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, truly I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of her who is your servant; by you have my cords been broken.

verses.en: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.pt: Sacrificarei a ti sacrifício de agradecimento, e chamarei o nome do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.
verses.en_bbe: I will give an offering of praise to you, and make my prayer in the name of the Lord.

verses.en: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,
verses.pt: Certamente pagarei meus votos ao SENHOR, na presença de todo o seu povo;
verses.en_web: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,
verses.en_bbe: I will make the offerings of my oath, even before all his people;

verses.en: In the courts of the LORD’S house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.pt: Nos pátios da casa do SENHOR, em meio de ti, ó Jerusalém. Aleluia!
verses.en_web: in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
verses.en_bbe: In the Lord's house, even in Jerusalem. Praise be to the Lord.
